title: Application and decision-maker
text:
19.48.020 Application and decision-maker.
A.	The waiver or exception petition shall be decided by the city plan commission in conjunction with the application for approval of the preliminary plat.
B.	A request for a waiver or exception pursuant to this chapter shall be submitted in writing by the subdivider with the filing of a subdivision application. The request shall state fully the grounds for the waiver or exception request and all of the facts relied upon by the subdivider. No waiver or exception may be considered or granted by the city plan commission unless the subdivider has made written request for such request at the time of the subdivision application submittal, or an amended subdivision application submittal.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
